summary: Arbor Realty Trust (ABR) priced $325M in Convertible Senior Notes due 2029 via a Rule 144A private placement, with an overallotment option for up to $375M. Concurrently, it repurchased shares: $11.6M for 2.1M shares via a concurrent share repurchase, and $102.7M via a prepaid forward stock purchase transaction. Proceeds also redeem $270M of 4.50% Senior Notes due Sept 2026 at par plus accrued interest. The prepaid forward is separate from the notes and does not affect noteholder rights. Net remaining proceeds go toward general corporate purposes. Watch for potential dilution from conversion and the effective deleveraging from the senior note redemption.
